description: This header defines test utilities, mock classes, and data structures for DNS testing within the Chromium project. It includes DNS query/response data, mock DNS client and transaction factory classes, and functions to build test DNS records and responses.

classes.name: MockDnsClientRule
classes.description: Defines rules for mocking DNS responses, including result types like success, failure, timeout, and malformed responses.

classes.name: MockDnsTransactionFactory
classes.description: Creates mock DNS transactions for testing, managing delayed transactions and probe runners.

classes.name: MockDnsClient
classes.description: Provides a mock DNS client that uses the mock transaction factory and rules for testing DNS behaviors.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsRecord
methods.description: Constructs a test DNS resource record with specified parameters.

methods.name: BuildTestCnameRecord
methods.description: Constructs a CNAME DNS resource record.

methods.name: BuildTestAddressRecord
methods.description: Constructs an A/AAAA DNS resource record.

methods.name: BuildTestTextRecord
methods.description: Constructs a TXT DNS resource record.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsAliasRecord
methods.description: Constructs an HTTPS alias DNS record.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceAlpnParam
methods.description: Builds an ALPN parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceEchConfigParam
methods.description: Builds an ECH config parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceMandatoryParam
methods.description: Builds a mandatory parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServicePortParam
methods.description: Builds a port parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceRecord
methods.description: Constructs an HTTPS service DNS record with specified parameters.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with specified answers and metadata.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response containing an IP address.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponseWithCname
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with an IP address and CNAME.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsTextResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with TXT records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsPointerResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with pointer records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsServiceResponse
methods.description: Creates a DNS response with SRV records.
